name: Medieval Christmas Market at Britz Palace
description: The Christmas market at Gutshof Britz has a Nordic and historical influence. A fairytale program makes the eyes of children and adults alike light up.

name: Christmas Flea Market on Kranoldplatz
description: The cozy Christmas flea market is expected to attract visitors to Neukölln's Kranoldplatz on the third Sunday of Advent with special offers.

name: Nowkoelln Xmas Flowmarkt
description: This Christmas market on Maybachufer attracts visitors with all kinds of handmade goods.

name: Rudow Christmas Mile
description: The former Rudow Advent Mile is expected to return as the Christmas Mile in 2026.

name: Advent Market in Alt-Buckow
description: An atmospheric Advent market has been held in Alt-Buckow on the first weekend of Advent for over 30 years. This year, it is being held at the Alt-Buckow estate.

name: Christmas Market on the Dicke Linda
description: Every year, the slightly sleepy Kranoldplatz in Neukölln hosts an relaxed Christmas market with charm and special offers.

name: Christmas Bazaar in Britz
description: The Marienfelder Weg allotment garden site attracts visitors to Britz on the second weekend of Advent with a Christmas market.

name: Christmas Market on Alexanderplatz
description: The Christmas market on Alexanderplatz in the heart of Berlin is a mix between traditional market, funfair and party.

name: Wintermünze
description: The Alte Münze in the Nikolaiviertel is transformed into a cozy winter market at Christmas time.

name: Bloody X-Mas Market
description: When Wacken Open Air and the Berlin Charité run a joint Christmas market, things can get bloody.

name: Christmas Bazaar in the Atrium of the Federal Foreign Office
description: The Christmas bazaar of the Federal Foreign Office attracts visitors with curiosities from all over the world.

name: Christmas Magic in Buch
description: In a historical setting, Berlin-Buch celebrates the holiday season with a medieval Christmas market.

name: Sustainable Christmas Market at Schönhausen Palace
description: The Sustainable Christmas market in Pankow takes place in a magical setting.

name: St. Nicholas Market at the Children's Farm Pinke-Panke
description: The Pinke-Panke farm hosts a Christmas festival for children on the second of Advent.

name: Advent Bazaar of the Kaspar Hauser Foundation
description: The Kaspar Hauser Foundation invites you once again to its traditional Advent bazaar this year – this time, however, on the grounds of the Konrad Duden School.

name: Spandauer Winterland
description: For the second time this year, a festive winter wonderland with a carnival atmosphere is being created on the former post office grounds in Spandau.

name: Christmas Market at Spandau City Hall
description: The Spandau Christmas Dream market attracts visitors with rides and a Christmas carnival atmosphere.

name: Christmas Market at the Evangelical St. John's Foundation
description: After a contemplative Advent service, the small Christmas market at the Evangelical St. John's Foundation (Evangelisches Johannesstift) in Spandau puts visitors in a festive mood.

name: Social Christmas Market in Spandau
description: Every December it gets Christmassy at the Goldnetz social market. The Social Christmas Market is primarily aimed at people with low incomes.

name: Arts and Crafts Christmas Market in Gatow
description: A well-rounded mix of arts and crafts, festive music and charitable causes characterizes the small and cozy Christmas market in Gatow.

name: Advent Market at Domäne Dahlem

dates.raw: On all weekends in Advent (November 28 and 29, December 5, 6, 12, 13, 19, and 20, 2026)

description: A cozy estate atmosphere, selected stalls and a colorful program for children: the Advent market at the Domäne Dahlem has a lot to offer.

name: Advent Market in Leonhardtstraße
description: On the second Advent, Charlottenburg's Leonhardtstraße is transformed into a cozy Advent mile where you can browse for presents.

name: Advent Market on Karl-August-Platz
description: Those in search of unique Christmas presents will find what they are looking for on the first three Sundays of Advent at the arts and crafts market on Karl-August-Platz.

name: Advent Market on Kollwitzplatz

dates.raw: On all Sundays in Advent 2026 (29 November, 6, 13 and 20 December 2026)

description: The Advent Market on Kollwitzplatz offers gifts, goods and foods produced under fair social and eco-friendly conditions.

name: Berlin Dog Christmas Market
admission: €2.50, of which €1 goes to an animal welfare organization
description: Berlin loves its four-legged friends! So it is not surprising that the dogs of the capital get their own Christmas market.

name: Christmas Fair on Landsberger Allee
description: The "Lichtenberger Winterzeit" Christmas fair attracts numerous guests to Lichtenberg with mulled wine and a funfair atmosphere.

name: Christmas in Westend
description: Every year during Advent, a Christmassy trunked animal invites you to the Christmas market in Preußenallee.

name: Christmas Market at Berlin City Hall
opening_times: Monday to Friday from 12 noon to 10 pm, Saturday and Sunday from 11 am to 10 pm, closed on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve, 3 January 2027 until 8 pm
description: A market alley, an ice skating rink around the Neptune Fountain, street artists, puppeteers, storytellers and more: the Christmas market at Rotes Rathaus has a lot to offer.

name: Christmas Market at Charlottenburg Palace
opening_times: Monday to Thursday from 1 pm to 10 pm, Friday to Sunday from 12 noon to 10 pm; closed on December 24
description: With its romantic setting and magnificent illuminations, the Christmas market at Charlottenburg Palace is popular with Berliners and visitors alike for good reason.

name: Christmas Market at Späth'sche Baumschulen

dates.raw: On the first three Advent weekends in 2026 (November 28 and 29, December 05, 06, 12, and 13)

description: Extensive stage program with a visit from an angel: For years, the Christmas market at Späth'sche Baumschulen has been a winter highlight for many families.

name: Christmas Market at the Berlin Animal Shelter
admission: 1 euro, free for children under six
description: The Berlin Animal Shelter traditionally organizes the "Christmas Festival for Animals" every year during the Advent season. The highlight is the gift-giving in the kennels and cabins.

name: Christmas Market at the Humboldt Forum
opening_times: 11 am to 10 pm, closed on November 22 and December 24, 2026
description: In 2026, a winter market with a special ambience will once again take place on in front of Berlin Palace and in the Schlüterhof.

name: Christmas Market in Alt-Rixdorf
opening_times: Friday from 5 to 9 pm, Saturday from 2 to 9 pm, Sunday from 2 to 8 pm
description: Cobblestones, warm light from oil lamps and a historical backdrop: The Alt-Rixdorf Christmas market on Richardplatz attracts visitors with its unique ambience and charitable commitment.

name: Christmas Market in Spandau
description: In Advent, the streets and alleys in the old town of Spandau change into a beautiful Christmas world complete with market stalls and a renaissance fair.

name: Christmas Market on Breitscheidplatz
description: This Christmas market in Berlin's western center is worth a visit while shopping on famous Kurfürstendamm.

name: Christmas Market on Gendarmenmarkt
description: Located on one of the most beautiful squares in Berlin, this Christmas Market offers quality decorations, food and entertainment.

name: Finnish Advent Bazaar
description: The Christmas traditions of the Nordic countries enjoy great popularity in December. In Kreuzberg, Christmas is celebrated the Finnish way with a bazaar at the Passionskirche on Marheinekeplatz.

name: Holy Shit Shopping
description: During Advent, the Haus der Visionäre in Friedrichshain is transformed into a design market offering creative gift ideas.

name: LGBTIQA Winterdays and Christmas Avenue

dates.raw: November 4 to December 23, 2026; closed on November 15 (Remembrance Day) and November 22 (All Souls’ Day)

opening_times: Monday to Thursday, 4 pm to 10 pm; Friday to Sunday, 3 pm to 10 pm
description: At the LGBTQIA Winterdays and the Christmas market on Nollendorfplatz, atmospheric lighting, a varied stage program and high-quality delicacies await visitors.

name: Lucia Christmas Market at Kulturbrauerei
opening_times: Monday to Friday from 3 to 10 pm, Saturday and Sunday from 1 to 10 pm
description: The Christmas market in the Kulturbrauerei attracts visitors with its contemplative atmosphere, a warm and cozy ambience and a daily cultural program.

name: Medieval Christmas Market at the RAW Compound
opening_times: Monday through Thursday from 3 pm to 10 pm, Friday from 3 pm to 11 pm, Saturday from noon to 11 pm, Sunday from noon to 10 pm; closed on November 22, 2026
description: This Christmas market in Friedrichshain presents itself in all its historical splendour.

name: Pankow Advent Market at Heynhöfe
opening_times: Saturday from 11 am to 8 pm, Sunday from 11 am to 7 pm
description: For several years now, the Heynhöfe business park has been transformed into a cozy Christmas mile in December where neighborhood residents, Berliners and visitors meet.

name: Sustainable Christmas Market on Sophienstraße

dates.raw: On all Advent weekends in 2026 (November 28 and 29, as well as December 5, 6, 12, 13, 19 and 21, 2026)

opening_times: Saturday from 12 noon to 8 pm, Sunday from 11 to 7 pm
description: For over 25 years, this Christmas market near Hackesche Höfe has offered visitors selected goods that are organic, sustainable and fairly produced.

name: Swedish Christmas Bazaar
description: With pytt i panna, marzipan cake, elk sausage, glögg and more, the Swedish Victoria Congregation invites Berliners to get in the mood for the Christmas season together on the first weekend of Advent.

name: Wein-Nachtsmarkt at Ludwig-Beck-Platz
description: Once again this year, a cozy Christmas market will take place on Ludwig-Beck-Platz. A visit is particularly worthwhile for wine lovers.

name: CJD Advent Market
description: Every year, original and lovingly handcrafted products from the Christmas workshop of the Christliches Jugenddorfwerk Deutschland are offered at the CJD Advent Market.

name: Winter Market at the Wendenschloss Lido
description: The Christmas market on the banks of the Dahme has become a crowd favorite with curling, carneval attractions, mulled wine variations and bonfires.

name: Danish Christmas Market
description: Christianskirkens julemarked, the Danish Christmas market on Brienner Straße, attracts visitors to Wilmersdorf with numerous Nordic specialties.

name: Christmas Market at Villa Donnersmarck
description: During Advent, Villa Donnersmarck transforms into a real Christmas house. Families with children in particular can spend a contemplative day at the Christmas market.

name: Christmas Market in Grunewald
description: Since 1976, the Grunewald Christmas Market has been held on the 1st of Advent around the Grunewald Church.

name: Caribbean Christmas Market at Yaam
description: The Yaam on Ice Christmas market beckons with Caribbean charm, reggae and dancehall for your ears, tropical Christmas creations and all kinds of unusual gift ideas.

name: Christmas Market at the Karlshorst Racing Track
description: This intercultural Christmas market takes place every year under the motto "The world at home in Karlshorst".

name: Christmas Market on Alice-Salomon-Platz
description: The family Christmas market in Hellersdorf will make children's eyes shine from the end of November.

name: Norwegian Christmas Bazaar
description: The Norwegian Church in Berlin traditionally organizes a cozy Christmas bazaar in Kreuzberg in the Advent season.

name: Christmas Market on Marzahner Promenade
description: This neighbourhood Christmas market attracts visitors to Marzahn with fire bowls, a colorful cultural program and an international range of foods and goods.

name: British Christmas Market
description: Under the motto "A Very British Christmas", the congregation of St George's Church in Charlottenburg organizes a cozy Christmas market every year.

name: African Winter Market
description: If you are still looking for unusual Christmas presents, you should stop by the African goods market: This is where African culture, fashion and cuisine come together.

name: Italian Christmas Market
description: Buon Natale! With numerous sweet and savory treats, the Christmas edition of the Italian Street Food Festival invites you to a calorie-rich Italian Christmas market.

name: Japan Market Christmas Edition
description: At the end of November, the Christmas edition of the Berlin Japan Market will once again take place at the Festsaal Kreuzberg.

name: Japanese Christmas Market of Manufactories
description: This Japanese Christmas market in Tiergarten is all about kōgei, the traditional crafts of Japan.

name: Japanese Christmas Market
description: This Christmas market is all about Japan. Visitors can sample Japanese food, make toys and purchase art and crafty gifts.

name: Winterquartier Berlin
opening_times:
Monday to Friday from 3 p.m. to 10 p.m.
Saturday and Sunday from 12 noon to 10 p.m.
Public holidays from 10 a.m.
Closed on December 24 and 25, 2025
description: A new Christmas world for Berlin: Christmas fans will find everything they could wish for at the Napoleon complex with a Christmas market, ice rink, curling and a cultural program.

name: Winter Market on Teufelsberg
description: Berlin's highest Christmas tree stands in the green Wilmersdorf district on the Teufelsberg: the Winter Market attracts visitors with an atmospheric program.

name: Culinary Christmas Market in Schöneberg
description: Always follow your nose: One of Berlin's most delicious Christmas markets is hidden in a Schöneberg courtyard.

name: Christmas Market in Zehlendorf
description: For five weeks, the old center of Zehlendorf in front of the town hall is illuminated in Christmas colors.

name: Winter World on Potsdamer Platz
description: Winter sports and Christmas markets come together at Potsdamer Platz during the Christmas season.

name: Weihnachtsrodeo Design Market
description: During Advent, the Colosseum hosts a Christmas market with a difference. Designers present creative gift ideas in a rather unique location.

name: Weddingmarkt - Christmas Edition
description: The Christmas Edition of the Weddingmarkt art market offers lots of unique gift ideas by local artists and designers.

name: Designer Christmas Market
description: This Christmas market in Kreuzberg offers jewelry, fashion, art and stylish home goods from some of the best local designers.

name: Winter Dream in Niederschöneweide
description: The Christmas rush returns to Treptow! Berlin's Winter Dream Christmas Market is back on Schnellerstraße this year.

name: Christmas Market on Wilmersdorfer Straße
description: The pedestrian zone on Wilmersdorfer Straße gets into the Christmas spirit at the end of the year.

name: Christmas Market at the Bröhan Museum
description: The small Christmas market in front of the Bröhan Museum has become a real insider tip thanks to its neighborly, typically Berlin atmosphere and a careful selection of stalls.

name: St. Nicholas Market at Charlottenburg City Hall
description: Since 2007, the Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf district office has been inviting visitors to its St. Nicholas Market at Charlottenburg City Hall every year.

name: KiezWeihnacht
description: Every year, visitors can stroll around the 60 stalls of this cozy neighborhood Christmas market in Friedrichshain's Samariterkiez.

name: All Inclusive Christmas Market at Spreespeicher
description: At this very special Christmas market near the Oberbaum Bridge, all foods and drinks are included in the market admission fee.

name: Heissa Holzmarkt
description: The winter market on Holzmarktstraße boasts a very special atmosphere, extraordinary foods and drinks and a diverse program for all visitors.

name: Glühwald at Uber Platz
description: Uber Platz is transformed into a cozy Christmas forest during the Advent season.

name: Kinky Christmas Market
description: The Berlin Kinky Christmas Market has been part of the capital since 2023 and is expected to return in 2026.

name: Merry Markthalle
description: Markthalle Neun is transformed into a cozy Christmas paradise during the Advent season.

name: Solidarity Winter Market in Görlitzer Park
description: The Solidarity Winter Market sees itself as an alternative to the many commercial Christmas markets in Berlin.

name: Advent Bazaar at the Christuskirche
description: On the Saturday before the first Advent, Christmas scents and sounds spread a contemplative atmosphere in Kreuzberg's Dieffenbachstraße.

name: Artisan Christmas Market at Gotisches Haus
description: Anyone looking for regional and handmade Christmas gifts should head to the arts and crafts market in Spandau during the Advent season.

name: Winter market in the Atelier Gardens
description: Enjoy the festive Christmas spirit with a clear conscience: the winter market at Atelier Gardens offers all kinds of sustainable products and gift ideas.

name: Christmas Market on Lehmann's Farm
description: Cozy Christmas in the south of Berlin: On the Lehmann farm in Marienfelde, visitors can enjoy a break from the big city while strolling through the local Christmas market.

name: Christmas Market in Lichtenrade
description: The Lichtenrade Christmas market is expected to take place for the 48th time in 2026. The old village green will be decked out in festive decorations during Advent.

name: Christmas at Tempelhof Airport
description: With a Christmas winter market, Christmas tree sale, a big Christmas carol sing and a children's program, the old fire station of the THF Tower will be a winter wonderland.

name: Christmas Market Around the Marienfelde Village Church
description: An association of several institutions celebrates the Christmas season in Tempelhof with a Christmas market around the village church of Marienfelde.

name: Christmas Market at Alpinia
description: Christmas coziness in Tempelhof: The Hotel Landhaus Alpinia is once again hosting a small but exquisite Advent market this year.
